title: SAST with F# semantic analysis and custom rules
objective: All first-party code is analyzed before merge by available .NET analyzers, F# analyzers (FSharp.Analyzers.SDK based) and Echelon custom semantic rules for prohibited constructs (dynamic SQL, dynamic code loading, unsafe interop, unrestricted deserialization); generated JavaScript bundles are analyzed separately.
implementing_systems: Praxis (CI workflow and provenance tooling exists; no security scanning step is configured)
not yet assigned (custom F# analyzers do not yet exist)
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)
residual_risks: Mainstream SAST engines (for example CodeQL) do not analyze F#; Roslyn security analyzers target C# and VB syntax; F# coverage depends on custom rules and compiler-enforced structure.

title: Software composition analysis on build and deployed inventory
objective: Every build and every deployed artifact SBOM is checked against vulnerability and license policy; unapproved or known-vulnerable dependencies above threshold fail the gate; deployed SBOMs are rescanned daily.
implementing_systems: Praxis (CI workflow and provenance tooling exists; no security scanning step is configured)
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Secret scanning with push-time blocking
objective: Secrets are blocked before reaching shared repositories, history, logs, images and AI agent transcripts are scanned, and any detected secret is treated as compromised and rotated.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Authenticated DAST and schema-driven API and boundary fuzzing
objective: A deployed test instance is scanned with authenticated DAST and schema-driven API tests including cross-tenant object access, and Limen boundary messages are fuzzed with invalid and oversized inputs.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: IaC, container and schema migration scanning with drift detection
objective: Infrastructure definitions, container images and Strata schema diffs are scanned before deploy for misconfiguration and security-relevant changes (grants, disabled row-level security, dropped audit triggers); deployed cloud configuration is compared continuously with the approved baseline.
implementing_systems: Strata (schema diff exists, pilot status, PG16 only; no security rules)
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Scanner validation against benchmarks and holdout fixtures
objective: Each scanner and rule set version is measured against public benchmarks and Echelon F# vulnerable and safe fixtures, including independently constructed holdout cases; regressions in recall block adoption of the new version; escaped defects become fixtures.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Fail-closed scan gates with protected configuration and governed suppressions
objective: Mandatory scans run on every merge and release from configuration the repository cannot change; missing evidence fails the gate; suppressions require a non-author human approver and expire; AI agents cannot alter scanner configuration or suppressions.
implementing_systems: Praxis (CI workflow and provenance tooling exists; no security scanning step is configured)
